subject: Sell-With integration: evidence, escrow and co-sell timeline
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Amy Wu <amy@cloudaxis.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Jun 2029 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sell-With integration: evidence, escrow and co-sell timeline

Hi Amy —

Thanks again for the demo last week. CloudAxis looks like a great fit for our ISV sell-with pilot. To keep momentum we want to capture the minimal evidence set and a tight timeline for the listing + co-sell enablement. Attached is a lightweight checklist to speed things up (partner-evidence-checklist.pdf).

High level asks from Redwood to get to a GCP/Azure listing + sell-with tag:
- SOC2 summary (scope and date) and point of contact for your security lead
- Architecture diagram that shows where customer data flows and which infra is customer-managed vs CloudAxis-managed
- Confirmation of metering/usage SKU mapping for Azure and GCP marketplaces (metering contract name)
- Legal contact for a quick reseller/addendum review (we aim to use a 1-page addendum)

Proposed timeline:
- June 25: Redwood reviews SOC2 + architecture (you send)
- June 28: Legal redline window; procurement kickoff
- July 3: DocuSign for addendum; enable marketplace test listing week of July 8

Can you confirm who will own SOC2 and procurement threads on your side? If we can get the SOC2 summary and architecture by EOD Tuesday (6/25) we can hit the July 8 milestone.

Thanks — and copying Ben and Vivek to align on any commercial asks.

—
Grace O'Connor
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Attachment: partner-evidence-checklist.pdf (1 page)

From: Amy Wu <amy@cloudaxis.io>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@cloudaxis.io>, Contracts Team <legal@cloudaxis.io>
Date: Tue, 25 Jun 2029 09:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Sell-With integration: evidence, escrow and co-sell timeline

Hi Grace —

Thanks for the clear outline. We're excited to move quickly. I'm attaching our SOC2 summary and a short architecture diagram pack (CAI-SOC2-summary.pdf). Procurement and Contracts are looped in here — their main asks will be: a short statement of the type of data processed, and a template reseller/addendum for signature.

Ownership on our side:
- SOC2 and architecture: me (Amy Wu)
- Procurement: procurement@cloudaxis.io (cc'd)
- Legal / contracts: legal@cloudaxis.io (cc'd)

Quick answers:
- We process customer inference telemetry (no PII), customer data regions are selectable at deployment time, and we can provide an architecture slide showing KMS integration and VPC peering.
- We can surface SKU-mapping for Azure first week of July.

We should be able to get the SOC2 summary and slides to you by EOD today. For the addendum: can Redwood share your preferred template or a short draft?

Best,
Amy
Director, Partnerships | CloudAxis Integrations
amy@cloudaxis.io

Attachment: CAI-SOC2-summary.pdf (2 pages)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Jun 2029 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Sell-With integration: evidence, escrow and co-sell timeline

Looping you all on Amy's note — she confirmed ownership and sent SOC2 summary. Two quick commercial points:

1) Addendum: I have a one-page Redwood sell-with addendum (redwood-docusign-addendum-v1.docx) that removes most procurement friction. We should send this to Contracts and Procurement as the starting doc.

2) Escrow / marketplace pre-req: if CloudAxis prefers an escrow notice for code or runtime artifacts we are flexible, but that'll add one week to legal review. Would prefer to avoid escrow unless CloudAxis requires it.

Action items for this thread:
- Grace: confirm you received CAI SOC2 and architecture pack (Amy attached)
- Vivek: can you confirm the SLA language we typically offer for sell-with listings (latency SLO + uptime target) so Contracts has a baseline?
- Olga: can you prepare the DocuSign envelope for the addendum once Grace confirms?

If Amy can get SKU mapping by July 2 we can still target the July 8 test listing.

—
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood-docusign-addendum-v1.docx (stub)

Subject: Re: Sell-With integration: evidence, escrow and co-sell timeline

Thanks everyone — good momentum. Quick updates and next steps from Redwood:

- Received CAI SOC2 summary and architecture pack (thank you Amy).
- Ben: baseline SLA for sell-with (for Contracts): Uptime target 99.9% monthly, latency P50 < 120ms for standard inference tier; we can add latency tiers for premium customers.
- Olga: please create the DocuSign envelope using redwood-docusign-addendum-v1.docx and include CloudAxis Contracts + Procurement as signers.
- Amy / CloudAxis: please confirm whether you require an escrow placeholder. If yes, let us know the desired language; otherwise we'll proceed without escrow and provide runtime attestations and a snapshot of our KMS & key rotation process.

Timeline (final):
- 6/30: Legal initial redline completed by CloudAxis
- 7/2: Redwood reviews redline and sends final DocuSign
- 7/3: Signatures complete (target)
- 7/8: Marketplace test listing (co-sell canary)

Links: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/DEAL-4227), DocuSign (https://www.docusign.com/en/link/redwood-sellwith-addendum-CAI), shared Drive (https://drive.redwood.com/shared/CloudAxis-evidence-binder)

Attached: canary-playbook.md (short checklist for enabling an initial co-sell test listing)

If we can get a green light on escrow language by EOD Monday (7/1) we won't slip the schedule. Appreciate the quick turnaround here.

—
Grace O'Connor
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
